name: Joining a Conversation
description: This microcredential celebrates your thinking about how students enter conversations, respond to multiple perspectives, and develop ideas across texts.
criteria:
**To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:**

* An insight you gained from completing the Atwoodian Table yourself, including how that experience may shape the way you introduce or scaffold it for your students.

* A comparison between this approach and how you have taught argument or multi-text responses in the past, noting what feels new, reinforcing, or transformative in your practice.

* An analysis of the text sets included in this module, highlighting what you notice about the range of perspectives, how they function as a conversation, and how these observations might inform your own decisions when beginning to curate a text set.

Description

This microcredential celebrates your thinking about how students enter conversations, respond to multiple perspectives, and develop ideas across texts.

Criteria

To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

  • An insight you gained from completing the Atwoodian Table yourself, including how that experience may shape the way you introduce or scaffold it for your students.

  • A comparison between this approach and how you have taught argument or multi-text responses in the past, noting what feels new, reinforcing, or transformative in your practice.

  • An analysis of the text sets included in this module, highlighting what you notice about the range of perspectives, how they function as a conversation, and how these observations might inform your own decisions when beginning to curate a text set.
